Build the validation setup for a koine-authored lens

Source: R/validation.R
koine_lens_validation_setup.Rd

Returns the prior draw, the model simulator, the sampler call, the parameters to rank, and a grid-exact reference-posterior builder for one of koine's koine-authored lenses ("dram", "pg_gibbs", "robust_t"). This is the shared harness behind sbc_check() and reference_posterior_check() for the recorded validation study; SBC simulates from the model returned here, so the calibration test sees the lens's own {prior, model, sampler} triple.

Usage

koine_lens_validation_setup(
  lens_id,
  n_obs = 40L,
  n_pred = 1L,
  nu = 4,
  fit_control = list(n_iter = 1500L, n_burn = 750L, n_chains = 2L),
  family = c("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"),
  n_groups = 12L,
  n_per_group = 6L
)

Arguments

lens_id

One of "dram", "pg_gibbs", "robust_t" (population) or "glmm_marginal", "nimble_glmm" (mixed-model lenses).

n_obs

Observations per simulated dataset (population lenses).

n_pred

Number of predictors beyond the intercept.

nu

Student-t degrees of freedom for "robust_t" (the generative model and the sampler share this value).

fit_control

A list of sampler controls passed to the lens fit.

family

For the mixed-model lenses, the response family ("gaussian", "binomial", or "poisson"); ignored by the population lenses, which carry their own family.

n_groups

Number of random-effect groups (mixed-model lenses).

n_per_group

Observations per group (mixed-model lenses).

Value

A list with generate, fit_fn, param_names, and reference.

Examples

setup <- koine_lens_validation_setup("dram")
setup$param_names
#> [1] "b_(Intercept)" "b_x1"          "sigma"
